verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm, but it ships client-facing technology (a trademark extranet, AI brief-analysis and contract-extraction tools, Fenwick Labs software), so a natural-language command interface is a fair question. None of the evidence shows users operating these tools through natural-language commands: the AI tools work by uploading documents, and the extranet uses tabs for search and reporting. The probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, so there is no agent-facing surface either.
